text: {"lessons":["My repeated changes in Stock C show the risk of reversing course without a clear thesis; I should set and review a reason for each trade before acting.","Trades should follow a consistent plan rather than react to one month’s price move; I should decide in advance what evidence would change my view.","I should keep a clear record of cash, share counts, and portfolio weights so each new trade fits the whole account, not just one stock."]}
